hooks.name: world_submit
hooks.neoforge: RenderLevelStageEvent (textured quads and text drawn right after the particles, before the hand)

doc_summary: `native_world_submit(draw)` runs once per extracted client world frame. `NativeWorldDraw` supplies the camera, partial tick, game time, light and a pose stack starting camera-relative; `translate_world([x,y,z])` subtracts the f64 camera before converting to f32. `native_world_quad(draw,sprite,corners,uv,rgba)` draws an unshaded atlas quad (UVs in 16 texels per sprite side; RGBA is four bytes). `native_world_text(draw,text,color,outline)` draws the actual styled font at (0,0), with ARGB colors and an optional eight-offset outline, and returns its advance. Both use lightmap light, normal fog, back-face culling, alpha blending and ordinary depth testing/writes. The outlined text's front uses the existing polygon-offset text pipeline. Geometry draws after particles, independently of block entities or source blocks, before the hand/HUD. No GPU objects are exposed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:world_canvas@.
